NONE: › a young cow, especially one that has not yet given birth to a calf (= baby cow)
（尤指未生產過的）小母牛
› used to express the fact that you cannot change a situation so you must accept it
嗨呵（表示厭倦或接受）
B1 the distance from the top to the bottom of something, or the quality of being tall
高，高度
B1 the particular distance that something is above a surface
（距離某平面的）高度
› high places, or the top of hills
高處；山頂

…的高潮（或高峰）

時尚的極致

example: a heinous crime
令人髮指的罪行

C: C2 [ C ] a person who will legally receive money, property, or a title from another person, especially an older member of the same family, when that other person dies
C usually singular: › [ C usually singular ] someone who now has responsibility for dealing with a problem or situation that existed or was created earlier
（負責繼續處理某一問題或局面的）繼承者
› [ C usually singular ] someone who continues to do the work of someone important who has died, or someone who has the same position as the previous person who held that position
（接替某重要位置的）接班人，繼任者

這位貴賓是統治全俄羅斯的羅曼諾夫王朝的王位繼承人。

NONE: › the person with the automatic right to legally receive all or most of the money, property, titles, etc. from another person when they die

NONE: › a woman or girl who will receive or already has received a lot of money, property, or a title from another person, especially an older member of the same family, when that person dies

NONE: › a valuable object that has been given by older members of a family to younger members of the same family over many years
